hintAfterSeconds.description: Seconds without progress before a hint shows

elder.description: The name of the elder who teaches

steps.description: The steps of the first lesson

goal.description: What the player must do at this step: gather, eat or tend

say.description: What the elder says at this step
say.example: Welcome, young one. First, food: right-click a berry bush and choose Gather.

hint.description: A hint shown when the player is stuck
hint.example: Berry bushes are the small green plants near the camp. Walk close, then right-click one.

done.description: What the elder says when the lesson is done
done.example: You know the first day. The rest is your life: press Esc for your bag, skills and the dominion.
